assignments.role: Frontend Admin Portal Standalone CSS & Offline Styling
assignments.scope: 1. In web/static/admin.html: The user reported that /admin lacks CSS (likely due to external CDN failure or missing standalone styles). Fully embed a complete, comprehensive, beautiful standalone Bootstrap 5-compatible CSS styling system directly inside <style> in admin.html (and/or local static CSS) with zero dependency on external network CDNs. Provide rich styling for: body, navbar, cards, stats badges, tables, modal overlays, modal dialogs, form inputs, buttons (.btn-primary, .btn-secondary, .btn-success, .btn-danger, .btn-dark, .btn-light), alerts, typography, and responsive grid layout for both mobile and desktop. 2. Verify all UI elements (login card, accounts table, create/edit modals, activity log modal, stats cards) look modern, polished, and beautifully styled even when completely offline. 3. Ensure zero occurrences of forbidden character U+0669. 4. Update tests/test_minimal_lok_and_admin_ui.py to verify standalone CSS embedded rules; update web/static/README.md; commit as MohammedBoure on frontend/agy51-admin-portal-standalone-css; notify coordinator.
